updateserver.name: PHP-Adminer
updateserver.desc: Manage your MySQL databases in the browser with Adminer: tables, data, SQL queries, import and export. Log in with one of your own MySQL users.
updateserver.authorname: Sentora for Ubuntu 26.04 (Adminer 6.3.0 by Jakub Vrana, adminer.org)
updateserver.updatedesc: Adminer in the panel's own style and its Light or Dark (it follows the panel, not the computer), the page in the panel's style (your MySQL users and databases, MySQL Users and New window), and its own sidebar icon.
